title: Mounts
intro: Census phase: vanilla data, plus the Ehlnofey target band of each record. Scope: horses, unicorns, reindeer, and the otherworldly horses (Arvak and the Daedric Horses; the summoned mounts are here by the user's choice and also on Conjured → *Constructs & Dragons*). The reindeer, the player's essential mount, is out of the rebuild's scope (`archetype-tiers.md`): its row keeps its vanilla level.
